sources.note: Official list of the international master's programmes (38 named, introduction says nearly 40); application period 5 to 19 January 2027
Tuition fees and scholarship programme: waivers are for tuition fee-liable students on the international master's programmes; no waivers for English-language bachelor's degrees

subject_rule: The scholarship is a tuition-fee waiver for tuition fee-liable students admitted to the University of Helsinki's international master's programmes; it is not tied to one field, but only the 38 programmes on the official list qualify, and each programme selects its own recipients.

notes: Recorded 38 master's programmes, the full official list; the page states no total beyond 'nearly 40' in its introduction, and 38 are named.

Names are as the official list writes them, including the acronyms in brackets. The list is not grouped by faculty and gives no ECTS or duration per programme (the One Health page read in the first pass shows 120 ECTS over two years).
The tuition page says annual fees are EUR 13,000, 15,000 or 18,000 depending on the programme and does not map fees to programmes; joint programmes may differ.

The tuition page does not say that the waiver applies to every programme on the list; it says each programme selects its own recipients and some may award only 50 percent waivers. The stored record had any_subject true; the source states no such thing, so false is given here for editors to confirm.
not_stated: Duration or ECTS per programme on the list page
Whether every one of the 38 programmes awards waivers in 2027
fetch_problems: The list page contains no links to the individual programme pages that the fetch tool could extract, so per-programme pages were not read.
